summary: Frontend E2E of the 4 new Capo-console changes PASSED on desktop 1920x900 after unlocking Master Gate PIN 1985 → Capo login admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! → dismissing briefing-start (Cyber-Trio). F1 Indice plance: console-index-open sticky bar with count 31, overlay opens with search + 31 items console-index-item-panel-*; filter 'week' narrows to 1 result (panel-weekly). Click console-index-item-panel-weekly closes overlay, scrolls panel-weekly into view (top=94px, inView=true) AND expands it (body visible). console-index-close X also closes overlay. F2 Piani chiusi: panel-weekly and panel-autoplan bodies are NOT visible at console load (both collapsed by default, only heads visible). F3 Assenze con orario: with shift-start-input=06:00 (server time ~03:23) → shift-team-absences-pending shown, shift-team-absences hidden; with shift-start-input=02:00 → shift-team-absences shown listing Marco; localStorage 'mikilab_shift_start' correctly persists '02:00'. F4 Report vocale: shift-team-report-toggle expands shift-team-report; shift-report-speak clicked with 0 new console errors (TTS silent-fail in headless as expected); shift-report-export still triggers CSV download 'mikilab_report_turno_2026-09-07.csv'. Regression: panel-dept-assign, panel-shift-templates, shift-team-announce, shift-team-recreate all present; shift-team-announce clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: ConsoleIndex filter is title-based, so the query 'settim' only matches when UI language = IT. In EN the weekly title is 'Weekly Plan · Products', so 'settim' returns 0. Consider indexing by testid / stable keywords too so language-independent searches work (this is a nice-to-have, not a bug — the spec assumed IT UI).
Two /api 401 errors still appear pre-auth (deptApi polling before login completes) — cosmetic, non-blocking.
briefing-start is the reliable way to dismiss the Cyber-Trio overlay; the top-right briefing-close X is also present and works. Both z-index 90 correctly stack above the console.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 features PASS + regression selectors present & clickable)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed for 2026-09-07: Panificio→Youssef(impasti, IN=present)+Marco(forni, absent). Present today shown as 1/2 (only Panificio assigned today). Marco correctly listed under 'Not clocked in yet · 1' after lowering shift-start to 02:00.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires (a) closing kiosk-modal if present, (b) JS .click() on admin-key-1/9/8/5 (Playwright .click sometimes drops taps), (c) email+password → click 'Sign in' (EN) or 'Accedi' (IT), (d) JS .click() on briefing-start to dismiss the Cyber-Trio overlay which has data-testid='shift-briefing' at z-index 90 — regular Playwright clicks fail because avatar images intercept pointer events. ConsoleIndex overlay is at z-[110], briefing at z-[90], so open the console index ONLY after briefing dismissed. Filter search in ConsoleIndex is language-sensitive (matches translated titles) — use 'week' in EN and 'settim' in IT.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All four MikiLab Pro Capo-console updates work as specified.
